title: finance
subHeroTitle: Complete financial control, multi-book accounting, and automated payroll
subHeroDesc: Manage multi-book accounting ledgers, issue custom recurring invoices, automate bank statement reconciliation, run employee payroll with digital payslips, and monitor 11 built-in financial reports — all inside your connected workspace.

sections.title: Multi-book accounting ledgers and granular general ledger tracking
sections.desc: Construct independent financial books for subsidiaries and business units, logging transactions across 9 distinct ledger types, multi-currency support, and multi-tier verification lifecycles.

gridItems.title: Multi-Book Management & Subsidiaries
gridItems.desc: Create and manage independent financial books for different companies, subsidiaries, or business units while keeping ledgers isolated and structured.

gridItems.title: Unified 9-Type General Ledger
gridItems.desc: Categorize every financial movement across 9 distinct transaction types — Revenue, Expense, Asset, Liability, Transfer, Investment, Tax, Refund, and Adjustment.

gridItems.title: Global Multi-Currency Support
gridItems.desc: Log transactions and generate financial statements across international currencies including INR (₹), USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), and custom global currencies.

gridItems.title: Granular Tagging & Verification Lifecycle
gridItems.desc: Tag transactions by Category, Vendor/Customer Entity, Project, and Department, while tracking verification states (Unverified, Matched, Reconciled, Verified) and payment status.

sections.title: Itemized invoice builder, automated recurring billing, and instant PDF emailing
sections.desc: Generate professional invoices with automatic tax and discount calculations, schedule recurring billing cycles, send client emails with PDF attachments, and collect payments via instant links.

gridItems.title: Itemized Invoice Builder & Instant Math
gridItems.desc: Generate customized, itemized invoices with line items, quantities, unit prices, tax percentages, subtotal calculations, percentage discounts, and net balance due.

gridItems.title: Lifecycle Tracker & Recurring Billing
gridItems.desc: Track invoices from Draft → Sent → Paid → Overdue → Cancelled, and schedule automated recurring billing on Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, or Yearly intervals.

gridItems.title: Pixel-Perfect PDF Generation & Emailing
gridItems.desc: Download pixel-perfect invoice PDFs directly inside your browser or email invoices to clients with custom messaging and embedded tracking.

gridItems.title: Instant Online Payment Collection Links
gridItems.desc: Generate and share secure online payment collection links directly with clients for rapid invoice settlement and instant ledger updates.

sections.title: Multi-account banking tracking, inter-account transfers, and statement reconciliation
sections.desc: Track bank accounts, credit cards, cash registers, and wallets in one dashboard. Bulk import banking CSV statements and run automated reconciliation engines for 100% accounting accuracy.

gridItems.title: Multi-Account Banking & Wallet Support
gridItems.desc: Manage Bank Accounts, Cash Registers, Credit Cards, and Digital Wallets in one place, storing IFSC codes, account numbers, opening balances, and live balances.

gridItems.title: Inter-Account Bank Transfers
gridItems.desc: Record bank-to-bank fund transfers between internal accounts with custom reference numbers, transfer fees, and complete audit trail notes.

gridItems.title: Banking CSV Statement Import
gridItems.desc: Bulk import bank statements in .csv format to quickly ingest external transactions, auto-matching records against existing ledger entries.

gridItems.title: Automated Reconciliation Engine
gridItems.desc: Reconcile bank statements against internal ledger transactions with automated matching rules to ensure 100% accounting accuracy.

sections.title: Automated employee payroll runs, digital payslips, and 11 financial reports
sections.desc: Process monthly payroll with PF and TDS tax deductions, export official digital payslips, and analyze business health using 11 built-in financial reports including P&L, Balance Sheet, Burn Rate, and Runway Estimators.

gridItems.title: Employee Directory & Salary Configuration
gridItems.desc: Manage employee profiles including Designation, Department, Base Salary, Bank Details, Account Numbers, IFSC codes, PF %, and TDS % tax settings.

gridItems.title: Automated Monthly Payroll Runs
gridItems.desc: Calculate gross salary, PF contributions, TDS tax deductions, reimbursements, bonuses, and net payouts in a single automated workflow.

gridItems.title: Digital Payslip Generation & Workflow
gridItems.desc: Preview and export official monthly payslips for employees while managing approval workflows from Draft → Pending Approval → Approved → Paid.

gridItems.title: 11 Financial Reports, Burn Rate & Runway Estimator
gridItems.desc: Gain total financial visibility with P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Revenue, Expense, Vendor Spend, Tax Reports, Monthly Burn Rate, and dynamic Operational Runway Estimators.

capabilitiesTitle: Total accounting clarity. Automated financial execution.
capabilitiesDesc: Connect multi-book ledgers, automated invoicing, banking statement reconciliation, employee payroll, and runway analytics in one connected platform.
checklistDesc: KeilHQ Finance & Bookkeeping unifies multi-book ledgers, invoice automation, bank reconciliation, payroll runs, and financial planning into one workspace.
checklistItems: Multi-Book Accounting & Subsidiary Isolation: Create independent financial books for different entities or subsidiaries while keeping ledgers isolated and organized.,
Unified 9-Type General Ledger: Track transactions across Revenue, Expense, Asset, Liability, Transfer, Investment, Tax, Refund, and Adjustment ledger categories.,
Global Multi-Currency Logging: Log transactions and generate reports across international currencies including INR (₹), USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), and global currencies.,
Granular Tagging & Verification Lifecycle: Tag transactions by Category, Entity, Project, and Department, while tracking verification (Unverified, Matched, Reconciled) and payment status.,
Itemized Invoice Builder & Instant Math: Generate custom invoices with line items, quantities, unit prices, tax percentages, subtotal calculations, percentage discounts, and net balance due.,
Automated Recurring Billing & PDF Emailing: Schedule recurring invoices (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly), export pixel-perfect PDFs, and send invoices to clients via email.,
Instant Online Payment Links: Share direct online payment links with clients for rapid collection and automated ledger reconciliation.,
Multi-Account Banking & Fund Transfers: Manage Bank Accounts, Cash Registers, Credit Cards, and Digital Wallets with IFSC code tracking and bank-to-bank inter-account fund transfers.,
Banking CSV Import & Reconciliation Engine: Import .csv bank statements to bulk ingest, match, and reconcile transactions against internal ledger records with 100% accuracy.,
Employee Directory & Salary Configuration: Maintain employee profiles with designation, department, base salary, bank account info, IFSC codes, PF %, and TDS % settings.,
Automated Monthly Payroll Runs & Digital Payslips: Calculate gross salary, PF contributions, TDS deductions, bonuses, and net payouts, generating downloadable digital payslips.,
11 Built-In Financial Reports & Runway Estimator: Analyze P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Revenue, Expense, Vendor Spend, Tax Reports, Monthly Burn Rate, and dynamic Runway Estimators.
